caption: This drawing depicts a nature scene with various animals and plants on a light beige background. In the center-left, there is a large, colorful bird with blue, pink, red, green, and yellow plumage perched on a brown tree branch. Near the lower left corner, a light brown deer with large antlers sits on green and yellow hills with red flowers. Above the deer and bird, there is a plant with blue, yellow, and green petal-like shapes. In the upper center and right, a tree with a brown trunk and green leaves is illustrated, bearing red circular fruits. Below this tree, on the ground, a small brown and white rabbit is visible, also sitting on green and yellow hills with red flower accents. A pink and green flower grows to the left of the rabbit. In the upper area of the image, two insects are flying: one red and the other yellow. The composition is framed by an irregular, rounded rectangular shape, with a broader beige border around the whole scene.
title: Crewel Embroidery Chair Seat
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
